messages:
eli: customer onboarding hit a weird one: their quickstart's require('redwood-sdk') throws 'Cannot find module' on their CI (Node 14).
fern: which sample + sdk version?
eli: quickstart-js, sdk@6.6.0. we moved to exports-only last week. package.json now has conditional exports with import/default but no explicit require/main.
maria: Node14 and older bundlers often don't honor the default fallback for require. some packagers (metro, older electron, pnpm hoisting) still expect a top-level main or explicit require condition.
sam: also saw a TS issue: vscode shows "Could not find declaration file" when importing with ESM bare import in a vite+ts project. exports wildcard mapping can confuse tsserver unless we expose a bare '.' export with types.
eli: repro here: in a Node14 container `node -e "require('redwood-sdk')"` fails. Runtime on Node16 works fine.
fern: short fix: publish a patch that adds top-level "main": "dist/cjs/index.cjs", add explicit "require" in exports for the bare entry, and include a top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts". add an exports entry for "./package.json" too.
maria: good. also add a typesVersions block or an explicit exports.types mapping so TS can resolve declarations under the exports map.
sam: add CI smoke tests: node14 require(), electron11 packager smoke, vite+ts hover check. That'll catch regressions.
eli: agreed. I'll ping the customer with a workaround: pin to 6.5.x or run examples with Node 16.
fern: long-term: write a devex guide with recommended package.json patterns for libraries shipping ESM/CJS + types, with examples for monorepos, bundlers, and edge runtimes.
maria: also document our policy on Node version support and deprecation window for CJS fallback so we can remove hacks cleanly later.
ops-bot: CI job samples/smoke node14 failed with exit code 1; created ticket devex#1123.
eli: opening PR to patch packaging and add tests. will include changelog note and quickstart README update showing both import() and require() examples.
fern: thanks. assign to sam for smoke tests and to maria for docs. :thumbsup:"
